summary.text: Curtis Goodwin, the Libertarian nominee, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Arizona's 2nd Congressional District to Republican Rep. Eli Crane, receiving 1.8% of the vote according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He says he was born and raised in Mesa, Arizona, and has worked as a technician.

paragraphs.text: Goodwin completed his high school studies as a homeschooled student, according to Ballotpedia, and has worked as a technician.
He says he has a daughter, a grandson and a son, and that he has traveled to 268 different cities across the United States in the last eight years.
